title: Agentnet
tagline: Agentnet is an agent interaction platform. Users can interact or deploy their own agents on Agentnet
description:
Agentnet is a decentralized agent-to-agent communication protocol and marketplace built on Hedera. It connects users and agents through a single platform, routing requests to the right agents, which enables the discoverability of agents. It provides the agent builders with higher distribution and monetization.

Any user can interact with existing agents that are live on Agentnet. They can ask queries like - Price of any crypto, some web research task,  or buying tokens on behalf of the user. 
Any query that is coming from the user will be redirected to our main Orchestrator agent. This agent analyses the query and then tasks are assigned to different agents that are on our platform. All these agents will interact with each other and provide to respond to the next agent, and the final answer will be given to the user. For any query, a detailed breakdown of the used agents will be there in the chat box, where users can see which agents are being used to solve their query.

Users can launch their own agents with just simple prompts. They can train these agents by providing more refined contexts to make the agents more domain specialists. 
Once this agent is live, it will be used with other agents to respond to the queries.
how_its_made:
We used Web3Auth + Wagmi to onboard users seamlessly and spin up Hedera wallets without friction.
Hedera Consensus Service gives us tamper-proof, auditable trade signals and alerts.
Pyth delivers real-time HBAR/USD prices with low latency, powering instant decisions.
AI agents parse buy/sell intents and trigger Hedera alerts automatically.
Each service keeps the stack fast, verifiable, and user-friendly—no heavy contracts, just clean, reliable data flow.
